questions.q: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.
o: as his health is not more good
attended the meeting
Neither my brother nor my brothers-in-law
questions.s:
Correct Answer: as his health is not more good

Explanation:

The phrase "not more good" is incorrect. The correct comparative form of "good" is "better." The corrected sentence should read:
"as his health is not better."

Corrected Sentence:

Neither my brother nor my brothers-in-law attended the meeting as his health is not better.

questions.s: Explanation:- Remove ‘more’ before ‘right’. kyunki 'right' adjective apne aap me absolute hai isko qualify karne ke liye koi adverb nahi lagega.

questions.q: She is_______a peacock in the blue satin saree. (SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
questions.s:
When we compare the beauty or qualities of one thing with another in a positive degree comparison, we use the structure: as + adjective + as
She is as beautiful as a peacock in the blue satin saree.

questions.q:
In the following question, one part of the sentence may have an error. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option.

The United Nations has (A)/ declared Finland as (B)/ a world's happiest nation (C)/ for the third consecutive year. (D)
questions.s:
Part C has an error.

'Happiest' is a superlative degree adjective. We always use the definitive article 'the' with a superlative degree adjective. So, the indefinite article 'a' should be replaced with the definite article 'the' to rectify the given sentence.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: The United Nations has declared Finland as the world's happiest nation for the third consecutive year.

questions.q:
Fill in the blank with a suitable adjective.

Anamika is a ____ child.
questions.s:
The given sentence shows no sign of comparison of superiority against others. So, a positive degree of adjective will be used. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

The final sentence will be: Anamika is a brave child.
